The privileged pacstrap builder for Omarchy bootstrap VMs — Omarchy's own
package sources plus the disk/bootstrap toolchain.
Built on the Omarchy base rather than plain Arch so that pacstrap resolves
EVERY package against Omarchy's frozen mirror snapshot. charly appends a
distro's extra repositories to the builder's pacman.conf but does not
repoint core/extra, so a plain-Arch builder would produce a target rootfs
mixing Omarchy's own packages with a newer upstream Arch snapshot — silently,
because pacman succeeds either way. Its own observable claim is that the
bootstrap toolchain is present AND that core still resolves to Omarchy.
